verdict.rationale: Jitsu ships a documented CLI (jitsu-cli init/deploy) for scripting workspace/functions workflows, a public Management API with OpenAPI reference, and explicit CI/headless MCP authentication via personal API key instead of browser OAuth, all of which support headless/CI automation. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of jitsu-cli or API usage in an actual CI pipeline, and no public OpenAPI spec was reachable in the probe.
